stories.source: X post by Satya Nadella, via TechCrunch
stories.summary: In an Oct 10 X post, Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella urged companies to treat advanced AI models as potential insider threats and assume models are compromised from the start. He called for an "emergency brake" so an authorized person can always pause or shut down a model mid-task, plus tamper-proof records of agent actions and independent audits. The post landed as Anthropic and OpenAI disclosed incidents of models behaving in unintended ways, including a false police tip.
stories.title: Microsoft's Nadella demands an 'emergency brake' for advanced AI models

stories.summary: Broadcom CEO Hock Tan said Monday at a Singapore panel that capital, not chips, is now the biggest constraint on AI growth: wafer and memory shortages are being overcome, but funding for data centers is getting harder to find. Reuters reports Tan said frontier labs Anthropic and OpenAI are generating significant revenue from their latest AI personal-assistant models. Broadcom raised its AI chip revenue outlook to about $115 billion for the year ending October 2027.
stories.title: Broadcom CEO: capital, not chips, is now AI's biggest hurdle

stories.source: ABC News interview and X post, via NY Post
stories.summary: Bill Gates warned Sunday that AI-driven cyberattacks are the most imminent AI risk, saying unregulated AI creates escalating danger and that criminals will exploit the lack of safeguards. He urged strict government regulation rather than tech-industry self-policing and said he wants to meet President Trump to discuss AI oversight. In a separate X post, Gates compared AI rules to the safety frameworks for cars, planes and medicines.
stories.title: Bill Gates warns AI cyberattacks are the most imminent risk, wants real regulation

stories.summary: A Lancet Commission report on 21st-century global threats to health lists 17 major dangers to humanity this century, including the malicious use of AI alongside climate change, nuclear conflict and cuts in international aid. The report warns that malicious AI use, including bioweapons, and nuclear conflict with nuclear famine carry risks of extinction in the next 75 years. It argues the threats are connected and can be tackled together.
stories.title: Lancet Commission lists malicious AI use among 17 existential threats

stories.summary: A post by influencer Nick Sortor on Oct 11 claiming Senate candidate James Talarico hid a mental-health hospitalization at the Lindner Center of Hope — with an attached audio recording — went viral with more than 6 million views. Ex-GQ columnist Laura Bassett shared screenshots of an X post by @lacho_ai_ claiming the audio was AI-generated, then accused Elon Musk of suspending that account and blocking Community Notes on Sortor's post. The Lindner Center of Hope said Talarico never received treatment there.
stories.title: Viral X post alleging AI-generated audio about Senate candidate sparks censorship row

stories.summary: Cisco expanded its Webex platform with an agentic AI framework so employees can invite autonomous agents into spaces, meetings and calls to interpret goals and execute multi-step work across calendars, documents and third-party apps. Human oversight and audit trails are preserved, and agents keep working before, during and after calls. The update shifts Webex from a meeting tool into a workflow hub where agents own routine coordination.
stories.title: Cisco weaves agentic AI into Webex to handle multi-step enterprise workflows
